sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "budget"."School_id" AS e, AVG("budget"."Invested") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("budget"."Budget_invested_percent" - "budget"."total_budget_percent_budgeted") AS REAL) / "budget"."total_budget_percent_budgeted")) AS m2 FROM "budget" GROUP BY "budget"."School_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: budget.relative difference of invested as percent of budgeted from budgeted share of total budget
why: average of amount invested per School (by School_id)
(invested as percent of budgeted - budgeted share of total budget) / budgeted share of total budget: the relative difference of two quantities in percent
average of relative difference of invested as percent of budgeted from budgeted share of total budget per School (by School_id)
gap to the all average of average of relative difference of invested as percent of budgeted from budgeted share of total budget (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "budget"."School_id" AS e, AVG((CAST(("budget"."Invested" - "budget"."Budgeted") AS REAL) / "budget"."Budgeted")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "budget" GROUP BY "budget"."School_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: budget.relative difference of amount invested from amount budgeted
why: (amount invested - amount budgeted) / amount budgeted: the relative difference of two quantities in USD
average of relative difference of amount invested from amount budgeted per School (by School_id)
index against the all average of average of relative difference of amount invested from amount budgeted (all level)
